The bowl is about 15 cm across and holds chia pudding with diced fruit on top. I read the fruit as mango or peach chunks; they are yellow-orange and look like fresh, unglazed pieces.

**Chia pudding:** it covers roughly 8 cm by 7 cm and looks about 3-4 cm deep, so I estimate about 150 g. Chia pudding is usually made with milk or a plant milk. I put it at about 110 kcal per 100 g.

**Fruit chunks:** there are about 9 pieces, each roughly 2 cm across. At about 4 g each that comes to about 50 g of fruit, at about 60 kcal per 100 g.
